agent_final:
Implemented and verified on commit `ad0ffc4` (`codex/08530a727264-cache-only-qk-norm`).

Diagnosis: `unified.qk_norm` emitted redundant `q_input_copy` and `k_input_copy` elementwise leaves around the required `q_norm` and `k_norm` RMSNorms. The model.work map assigns the copies no semantics; Analyzer reports zero necessary work for both (`pred.casev0.optimality-kernel-ladder`, `pred.casev1.optimality-kernel-ladder`).

Fix: disabled `BeforeRecipe::COPY_INPUTS` in [qwen3_dense_vllm_before.rs](simulator/src/arch/qwen3_dense_vllm_before.rs:14), leaving norm dimensions and all other computation unchanged. The strict cache-only bridge is in [timing_predict.rs](simulator/src/timing_predict.rs:239); misses now error instead of enabling JIT profiling. The location map and focused tests were updated accordingly.

Evidence, simulated prediction GPU-seconds:
- Before leaves: `q_input_copy`, `q_norm`, `k_input_copy`, `k_norm`. R0 `0.00047138`; R5 `0.000088768495375`; R6/R7 `0.000000001792`.
- After leaves: `q_norm`, `k_norm`. R0 `0.000272748` (42.14% lower); R5 `0.0000443842525` (50.00% lower); R6/R7 unchanged at `0.000000001792`.

Reports: [before scope](logs/eval_before_baseline/reports/optimality_scoped_label_iter_unified_qk_norm_qknormlocalworklet_local_1_gpu_qo_num_qo_8a2f608c17bd.json), [after scope](logs/eval_before_run/reports/optimality_scoped_label_iter_unified_qk_norm_qknormlocalworklet_local_1_gpu_qo_num_qo_55d4ec34f709.json), [before breakdown](logs/eval_before_baseline/reports/iter_breakdown.ans), [after breakdown](logs/eval_before_run/reports/iter_breakdown.ans). Both predictions ran with an empty CUDA device mask, no `--profile`, and the warm cache. Focused Rust tests and `git diff --check` passed; unrelated worktree changes remain untouched.

judge.reasoning: The agent independently identified the same redundant Q/K input copies in the qk_norm/RMSNorm path. Disabling COPY_INPUTS removes both copies while preserving the necessary q_norm and k_norm computations.
